optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source snapshot, offline normalization, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Block labels
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: direct fields on the parcel feature keyed by ACCOUNT

optionalLayers.label: Parcel dimensions
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: direct land area fields on the parcel feature keyed by ACCOUNT

optionalLayers.label: Permits
optionalLayers.source: Fort Worth Accela permit service discovered for Fort Worth only; remaining jurisdictions and reuse rights unresolved
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: jurisdiction-gated normalized address plus point-in-polygon; never claim countywide coverage from a municipal source

optionalLayers.label: Zoning intelligence
optionalLayers.source: Fort Worth official zoning service discovered for Fort Worth only; remaining jurisdictions and reuse rights unresolved
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: jurisdiction-gated polygon intersection; never assign Fort Worth zoning outside the verified Fort Worth boundary
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time fetch, offline join, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Floodplain intelligence
optionalLayers.source: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer candidate discovered; bounded Tarrant extract, reuse rights, and spatial joins unresolved
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: county-boundary clip followed by parcel intersection and centroid classification with ambiguous overlap counts
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time fetch, offline parcel join, viewport-safe sharded parcel ID lookup, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Development signals
optionalLayers.source: Official Fort Worth and Arlington permit and zoning-case candidates; immutable records, classification approvals, parcel links, and lifecycle audits unresolved
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: Only certified normalized events with explicit approved rules and certified parcel links may enter the parcel development index
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: offline event classification, deduplication, lifecycle aggregation, exact link audit, and viewport-safe parcel lookup after certification

optionalLayers.label: Migration and demand intelligence
optionalLayers.source: IRS county migration verified; ACS 2024 credential-blocked; QCEW 2025 archive capture pending; municipal supply coverage incomplete
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: Preserve source geography, unit, vintage, release time, and margin of error; never attribute county observations to parcels without parcel-specific evidence
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: offline point-in-time feature construction with source snapshots, temporal leakage checks, geography controls, backtesting, explainable formulas, and viewport-safe geography lookup after certification

optionalLayers.label: Production PMTiles delivery
optionalLayers.source: Exact 758633-parcel viewport chunk bundle with certified output lineage; raw-source lineage, tiling tool, artifact, and CDN delivery remain blocked
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: Stream bounded parcel chunks into a privacy-minimized vector layer; verify exact counts, PMTiles header, decoded samples, immutable hash, byte ranges, CORS, cache policy, and viewport fallback before activation
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time offline chunk streaming into PMTiles with bounded viewport fallback and no browser-side full-county geometry load

ownerEnrichment.sourceLabel: Tarrant Appraisal District parcel feature service
ownerEnrichment.propertyRecordSource: Official TAD parcel layer exposes owner, situs, legal, land, improvement, and value fields on each geometry feature
ownerEnrichment.officialJoinKey: TAD Parcel.ACCOUNT (complete and one feature per ACCOUNT in the 2026-08-06 live-source audit)
ownerEnrichment.noOfficialEmailFieldNote: The official parcel layer does not expose owner phone or email. Do not infer them.

fields.ownerName2: not available in verified live parcel layer
fields.businessName: OWNER_NAME when the recorded owner is an entity; do not infer classification
fields.ownerMailingAddress2: not available in verified live parcel layer
fields.ownerPhone: No official owner phone field verified
fields.ownerEmail: No official owner email field verified

joinKeys.primaryParcelAccount: TAD Parcel.ACCOUNT; verified non-null on 758633 of 758633 live features and one feature per ACCOUNT on 2026-08-06
joinKeys.appraisal: direct fields on the same TAD Parcel feature keyed by ACCOUNT: APPRAISEDV, LAND_VALUE, IMPR_VALUE, TOTAL_VALU
joinKeys.land: direct fields on the same TAD Parcel feature keyed by ACCOUNT: LAND_ACRES and LAND_SQFT
joinKeys.secondaryParcelGisId: TAXPIN; GISLINK is also complete but remains a source-specific link identifier
joinKeys.blockLabels: pilot: direct key, spatial join, or unavailable
joinKeys.dimensions: pilot: direct key, spatial join, or unavailable
joinKeys.permits: jurisdiction-gated normalized address plus spatial verification; Fort Worth evidence cannot be applied countywide
joinKeys.zoning: jurisdiction-gated polygon spatial join; municipal zoning cannot cross a verified city boundary
joinKeys.floodplain: FEMA county-boundary clip plus parcel polygon intersection and centroid classification; exact ambiguous overlap counts required
joinKeys.developmentSignals: certified permit, zoning-case, plat, demolition, occupancy, or capital-project event plus approved classification rule and certified parcel link; candidate records never equal signals
joinKeys.migrationDemand: source-geography observations with exact unit, period, release time, lineage, uncertainty, and point-in-time validation; county metrics never become parcel facts

productionGap: Tarrant has 13/14 pilot intelligence groups when partial Fort Worth/Arlington permit, zoning, and development coverage plus the 2025 regulatory-candidate flood layer are included. Migration-demand and production activation remain blocked; uncovered jurisdictions stay explicit.
pilotNotes: Do not activate this county in the app until county QC is regenerated and the remaining intelligence-layer and activation gates are reviewed.
